en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, two‑storey, ivy‑covered building along a street. People are standing and sitting near a picket fence and at outdoor tables. The roof is steep and tiled, and there is a decorative metal gate at the right. Printed red text at the top reads "Meissen. Weinschank zum Winzerhaus." and a handwritten red number appears in the upper right. A hanging sign and a wall sign advertise the wine tavern.
